search_window.basis: Bounded since the latest independently read-back confirmed Food Line Source Watch heartbeat ending 2026-10-31T01:46:06.697-07:00. Search recency of two days compensates for indexing latency, but old event/publication dates are not eligible.

coverage_notes: Supplementary recall-only sweep, not authoritative primary nationwide production collection. No review approval, public publication, schedule alteration or task disabling.

All 12 web searches returned normally: 4 sole/last/full-service grocery losses; 3 disaster-related distribution cancellations; 2 abrupt pantry or food-bank access losses; 3 official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions.

No new, independently substantiated, qualifying U.S. disruption dated or newly disclosed inside the bounded observation interval. This does not assert exhaustive coverage of unindexed local provider notices or social posts.

Excluded old U.S. grocery losses: Eastport, Maine (reported September 3, 2026); Spencer, New York (September 11-14, 2026); North Charleston, South Carolina (August 2026). Reopening in Gordon, Georgia reported October 30, 2026 restores access rather than disrupting it.

Excluded older SNAP government shutdown notices from October 2025 and stale WIC/SNAP guidance mistakenly surfaced by search date matching. No fresh agency-confirmed food benefit interruption or actual payment outage was evidenced.

Kauaʻi Hurricane Lowell relief pages located by search describe prior distributions/recovery services, not a new storm-related cancellation in this interval. Generic emergency recovery pages without canceled food services were excluded.
No donation drives, resource guides, routine promotions, inflation coverage, unverified outage aggregators, or duplicated historical incidents were admitted as findings.
